subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should durable wake handoffs be allowed to cross `/new` or `/reset` into a replacement session generation as part of the proposed durable-core contract?
rationale: The current implementation deliberately uses a systemEvent that survives session replacement, while the sibling agentTurn queue fails closed with expectedSessionId; choosing which behavior is the durable product contract affects session state, message delivery, and the cumulative stored-state/API surface.

options.title: Fence to the resolved generation
options.body: Carry the resolved session id or generation into the queue entry and skip delivery after a reset, matching the existing agentTurn safety contract.

options.title: Sponsor cross-reset delivery
options.body: Explicitly define wakes as session-key obligations that survive reset, then document and prove why delivery into the replacement session is safe.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Keep the existing session-delivery queue unchanged and defer the cumulative durable-runtime surface until its lifecycle policy is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Fence to the resolved generation
recommendation.body: Carry the resolved session id or generation into the queue entry and skip delivery after a reset, matching the existing agentTurn safety contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly extends the session-delivery queue and restart-recovery behavior introduced in their adjacent merged work.
